scope: Advisory automated checks only. Speaker consistency does not prove absolute named identity.

measurement_protocol.selection: all retained B source files, fixed start10000ms/duration25000ms; no reselection
measurement_protocol.calibration_split: sorted known catalog reader IDs, alternating IDs before scores
measurement_protocol.identity_limit: Catalog name labels are provisional; consistency is not proof of named identity.

V1.limitations: Folder/channel correspondence and content uniqueness are provenance evidence, not absolute voice-name identity.
